svg.text: Code walkthrough — Docker Compose path (docker/deploy.sh and generators)
The numbered boxes are the order deploy.sh runs in. Left: inputs it reads. Right: files it writes and containers it starts.
volume vllm-model-cache-<i> · shm · memory limit (80g default)
then: volumes · networks · rm stale file · generate_litellm_config
drop the OTHER engine's compose file (no stale definitions)
• deploy.sh is re-runnable: unchanged model containers are not restarted (--no-recreate); LiteLLM is only recreated/restarted when its inputs changed.
• Secrets live in vault.yml and stay stable across runs; --down deletes volumes because passwords would otherwise mismatch the initialised databases.
• Switching serving_engine removes the other engine's compose file and containers but keeps model caches (named volumes), so switching back re-downloads nothing.
• Containers drop all capabilities; Flowise is loopback-only until its first owner exists.
Source: docker/deploy.sh, docker/scripts/generate-docker-compose.sh, docker/scripts/generate-vault-secrets.sh, docker/docker-compose.yml. Drawn for study.
